name: Lenia
description: Continuous generalisation of Conway's Game of Life developed by Bert Wang-Chak Chan that supports a vast zoo of life-like self-organising patterns in continuous space, time, and state. Lenia is used to study artificial life, morphogenesis, and the emergence of complex structure from local interaction rules.
reputation: Highly cited in the artificial life community; generated significant interest for producing diverse, lifelike patterns with a compact mathematical framework.
notes: Research artefact and visualisation tool; no standardised benchmark tasks. Computationally intensive for high-resolution simulations.
